channel.title: Contrl Blog
channel.description: RFP analysis, win themes, scoring tables and more: practical guides for people who write proposals.

item.title: Customer and Competitor Intelligence: Seeing Your Bid Through the Customer's Eyes
item.description: Customer intelligence explains what the buyer needs; competitor intelligence explains how the buyer sees each bidder. A practical guide to the APMP Body of Knowledge on collection plans, sources, ethics, bidder comparison matrices and SWOT.
item.dc:creator: Junho Cho

item.title: Value Propositions: Give the Customer a Reason to Choose You
item.description: A value proposition says how your offer will improve the customer's business and how that will be measured. The APMP Body of Knowledge on its five elements, stakeholder value propositions, quantifying payback and proof points.
item.dc:creator: Junho Cho

item.title: Capture Strategy: How Professionals Win Before the RFP
item.description: An opportunity/capture strategy is your plan to win one specific bid. A practical walkthrough of the APMP Body of Knowledge on strategy vs. tactics, hot buttons, the three buyer types, the bidder comparison matrix, strategy statements and ghosting.
item.dc:creator: Junho Cho

item.title: Customer Relationship Management: Win Before the RFP Is Released
item.description: Customers pick the bidders they know, like and trust. A practical walkthrough of the APMP Body of Knowledge on CRM: starting early, RFP shaping, contact plans, strategic customer meetings and a consistent message.
item.dc:creator: Junho Cho

item.title: Compliance vs. Responsiveness: The Two Things Every Winning Proposal Gets Right
item.description: Compliance keeps your proposal from being eliminated, and responsiveness is what beats the competition. A practical walkthrough of the APMP Body of Knowledge on identifying requirements, building compliance and response matrices, and handling non-compliance.
item.dc:creator: Junho Cho
